overview: Central Vietnam is ideal for families: Da Nang's long beach and Ba Na Hills, the lantern-lit old town of Hoi An, and an overnight cruise on Ha Long Bay in the north.
fit: Great for both; Ba Na Hills and lanterns are big wins with kids.
season: February to April is best for both Da Nang and Ha Long Bay. Central Vietnam's rainy season is September–December (typhoons). Summer is hot.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Da Nang or Hanoi (1-stop; some direct seasonal flights from India)

gettingAround: Grab cars are cheap; a driver for day trips.

todo.title: Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge
todo.why: Cable car, French village, Fantasy Park

save: Vietnam is very good value once there
Book Ba Na Hills online for discounts

safety: Crossing roads: walk slowly and steadily through scooter traffic
kids: Lantern boats in Hoi An are pure magic for the 4-year-old
Plan rest days between big outings
visa: E-visa online for Indian citizens, about US$25 per person, valid up to 90 days; apply only on the official government e-visa site, at least a week ahead.
